# States
Shy Guy has several unique states that determine its capabilities and mechanics.
When playing as Shy Guy, you can identify your state by the representation of your face on the status-effect panel to the right. Hovering over it displays a more detailed description and comments from your inner "voice" about the situation.
Complex personnel can identify Shy Guy's state by the sounds it makes. Some states also have distinctive actions or appearances.
[textlink="General information about Shy Guy" link="Scp096About"]
## Normal
In this state, Shy Guy moves slowly and cannot attack. This is the default state the object enters when it spawns in the round.
To enter another state, it must [bold]tear the skin from its face[/bold] or wait until [bold]someone sees its face[/bold] in person or in a photograph.
This state can be identified by the sound of crying or by Shy Guy's slow movement speed.
## Pre-Enraged
In this state, Shy Guy cannot move, trembles, and makes a loud sound. The state lasts 40 seconds, after which Shy Guy automatically enters the Enraged state.
[bold]Shy Guy enters this state after someone sees its face. This can happen:[/bold] - In person, when you and Shy Guy look directly at each other's faces. - In a photograph. Examining it is enough.
This state can be identified by the object's loud sound and trembling.
## Enraged
Upon entering this state, the object hunts down anyone who saw its face and brutally kills its targets.
[bold]Shy Guy enters the next state when [/bold] - It kills all its targets, or they cease to exist - About 4 minutes have passed since the state began
This state can be identified by Shy Guy's loud roar, high speed, and purposeful movement through the complex.
## Sleeping/Sitting
In this state, Shy Guy cannot move and is left vulnerable. It can enter this state in the following ways: - By leaving the Enraged state. It will wake up after some time - By using the "Sit down" ability. It can quickly stand back up - By depleting all its stamina and becoming stunned. It will stand up again after some time.
In this state, Shy Guy cries more rapidly and produces more tear fluid. It can also be dragged.
This state can be identified by its unique appearance: the object "sits" while making a crying sound.
## Flayed Face State
A unique state that occurs when the object tears all the skin from its face, erasing all of its features.
[textlink="More about abilities" link="Scp096Abilities"]
In this state, it can freely attack complex personnel, open closed airlocks and blast doors, and move slightly faster.
Until its face is restored, seeing it will not cause the object to enter the Enraged state, even when looking at a photograph.
To leave this state, its face must be restored. This happens automatically 15 minutes after entering the state. The process can be accelerated by manually treating the face with bandages.
[textlink="More about restoring containment" link="Scp096Containment"]
This state can be identified by the unique "noisy" sound coming from the object and by its unrestricted movement through the complex.
